sympy__sympy-11400.instruction: Repair the C printer so symbolic equality and ordering relations produce valid C operators, and sinc has its removable singularity handled when emitted as C. Preserve existing printer behavior and formatting. Explore the repository and run its visible tests.

sympy__sympy-11897.instruction: Repair LaTeX printing of Piecewise inside multiplication: delimit the Piecewise factor so the product remains unambiguous, including noncommutative factors on either side. Preserve the standalone and itex forms. Explore the repository and run its visible tests.
